title: Beyond Compression: Diagnosing How Post-Training Changes Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training is central to mathematical reasoning in modern large language models (LLMs), but endpoint pass@1 alone underidentifies what has changed. Gains may reflect newly reachable solutions, cheaper sampling of latent solutions, surface robustness, or memorisation. We compare three post-training paths under a common diagnostic readout: our sufficiently trained off-policy distillation trajectories, released Qwen3 off-policy-plus-on-policy distillation endpoints, and a released DeepSeek-Math endpoint trained with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO). Our probe uses cross-surface pass@K over verbatim prompts, paraphrases, numerical isomorphisms, and translations, plus consistency, distribution-shape, and verified supervised-fine-tuning (SFT) membership analyses. translated_title: 超越压缩：诊断后训练如何改变数学推理
translated_abstract: 后训练对于现代大型语言模型（LLM）的数学推理至关重要，但仅凭端点的 pass@1 指标无法充分识别究竟发生了什么变化。性能提升可能反映了新可达的解、对潜在解更廉价的采样、表面鲁棒性，或者记忆化。我们在统一的诊断框架下比较三种后训练路径：我们充分训练的离策略蒸馏轨迹、已发布的 Qwen3 离策略加在策略蒸馏端点，以及使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练的已发布 DeepSeek-Math 端点。我们的探测方法使用跨表面的 pass@K，涵盖逐字提示、改述提示、数值同构变形和翻译，并结合一致性、分布形状以及经过验证的监督微调（SFT）成员资格分析。我们发现了两种情形：在较简单的 AMC 问题上，大 K 值的天花板已接近饱和，因此后训练主要压缩了采样成本；而在更难的 AIME 问题上，后训练（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个超越端点 pass@1 的跨表面诊断框架，揭示了后训练对 LLM 数学推理的双重作用机制：在较简单的 AMC 问题上主要压缩采样成本，而在更难的 AIME 问题上则以其他方式改变推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cross-surface diagnostic framework beyond endpoint pass@1, revealing the dual mechanisms by which post-training changes LLM mathematical reasoning: mainly compressing sampling cost on easier AMC problems, while altering reasoning capability in other ways on harder AIME problems.
